findings.title: Avoid float rounding when coercing real values to integers
findings.description: `as_integer` converts non-`Integral` `Real` values to `float` before checking whether they are integral. This can silently change the value: `Fraction(9007199254740993, 1)` rounds to `9007199254740992.0` and is returned as the wrong integer. Since parameter binding uses this conversion, a supplied value can be accepted but bound incorrectly. Check integrality and convert without first rounding through `float`, and add coverage for large rational values.

findings.title: Validate timestamp meaning before formatting the error
findings.description: `Timestamp` validates its nanoseconds but does not validate `meaning`, so `Timestamp(1, "bad")` can be constructed. When `SignalEvent` rejects that timestamp, the error message accesses `self.time.meaning.value` and raises `AttributeError` instead of `InvalidSignalError`. Validate that `meaning` is a `TimeMeaning` before accessing `.value` (or format the invalid value safely).
